title: AI-Discovered Cognitive Models Reveal Novel Insights into Human and Animal Learning

parentSelection: One current program edited; fitness-preferred sampling, exact pool/rule unspecified

mechanism.domainTask: Evolutionary discovery of interpretable cognitive learning models from behavioral data
mechanism.populationDetail: DataDIVER delegates evolutionary search to AlphaEvolve and reports score-preferred program sampling, but does not describe population organization.
mechanism.archiveDetail: The paper does not specify whether AlphaEvolve maintains a separate elite archive or how programs are preserved.
mechanism.replacementDetail: AlphaEvolve search-state and candidate replacement internals are outside the method details reported here.
mechanism.generationDetail: AlphaEvolve edits one current parent using exact SEARCH/REPLACE blocks limited to at most four contiguous source lines and the smallest independent change; prior programs are contextual examples.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Fitness values guide AlphaEvolve's preferential sampling; objective scores themselves are not separately described as prompt feedback.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The prompt contains one current program; AlphaEvolve is said to preferentially sample higher-scoring programs, but its program-pool structure and sampling formula are not detailed.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: Sequential scientific-model search optimizes predictive fit and interpretability-related complexity under multiple fit floors, then applies a function-preserving readability refactor.
